summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about its subsidiary KeepZone AI entering a white label agreement to develop an AI-based voice communication decision support system. The agreement involves rights to develop and commercialize an AI platform under the KeepZone brand for homeland security. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine product development agreement, not a special situation. The filing is an ordinary current report, not a transaction requiring classification under special-situations categories.
